info.title: EventJunction API
info.description: Use Authorize with an API key. Read-only keys are the default. Creating or updating records requires a workspace-scoped key with the corresponding write permission.

get.description: Returns event records and recurrence definitions. Use calendar occurrences for expanded dates.

parameters.name: starts_after
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on the event start.

parameters.name: starts_before
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on the event start.

post.description: Requires events:create. New events default to draft.

get.description: Returns events overlapping a window of up to 93 days, sorted by start. Limited to 500 candidate events and 5,000 occurrences.

get.summary: List events using the legacy format
get.description: Returns records grouped by template name. Filtering by template returns a flat list. An empty result has HTTP 200 and a body status of 204. New clients should use /api/v1/events.

200.description: Event templates in the current workspace
Field definitions in the current workspace
Account profile with the current workspace ID

put.description: Requires events:update. Send the complete editable record. An imported event is updated in EventJunction only.
Requires templates:update. Send the complete editable record.
Requires templates:update. Send the complete editable record.

status.description: Required for PUT. POST defaults to draft.

layout.description: Field IDs grouped by column. Each field appears once.

field_id.description: Required on POST. Stable key used in event custom_fields.

id.description: Event ID and original local date. Rescheduling retains this ID.

Forbidden.description: The key or workspace role lacks permission, or the workspace is unavailable

NotFound.description: No matching record in the selected workspace

InvalidParameters.description: Invalid parameters or occurrence limits exceeded

RateLimited.description: Versioned requests are limited to 60 per minute per authenticated user

Source.name: source
Source.description: Provider key. Omit to include all sources. Native events use eventnest.

Status.name: status
Status.description: Use published for a public listing. Authenticated requests can also return drafts.
